Advanced computing debt issuance exceeded $680 billion, while major tech firms hold over $3 trillion in off-balance-sheet commitments. Eighty-seven percent of surveyed institutions identified AI as a significant financial stability risk. title: 花店老板接到4781元订单，客人要求用百元大钞做“现金花束”，老板直接报警，获重大线索奖 | 原文
content: In November, a Chengdu florist reported an online order for a 4,781 yuan “cash bouquet” made of 100-yuan bills. Suspecting fraud, the owner contacted police instead of accepting it. Detectives acted within two hours, apprehending four suspects involved in laundering stolen money. The florist was awarded a tip fee for providing the critical lead.
